description: Vulnerability audit of up to 200 pinned dependencies in one call against the OSV database (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, Cargo, NuGet). Accepts a package list or a package.json (dependencies and devDependencies, range prefixes stripped). Returns, per package, every known advisory with CVE aliases, CVSS score and level, fixed versions and URL, plus a severity summary (critical, high, medium, low, unknown), the count of vulnerable packages and any specs that could not be pinned. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

ecosystem.description: npm (default), pypi, go, maven, cargo or nuget

package_json.description: A package.json object; dependencies and devDependencies are audited (npm only)
